revisions.new_reading: Humanity upon the wane should now also be understood as total erasure where all human activity and memory have been swept out of existence, leaving only frail creatures.
revisions.old_reading: Humanity upon the wane is now to be understood as differentiation into two distinct species, not simple decline of a single humanity.
revisions.rationale: The civilization-swept-into-oblivion claim turns a gradual wane into a completed sweep out of existence.

revisions.new_reading: The unplaced memory of meat seen in the Underworld should now be understood as a shivering realization that the meat was likely the flesh of the frail prey species.
revisions.rationale: The horrible realization about meat resolves the previously unplaced intrusive memory into a specific dread about what was seen.

revisions.new_reading: The Morlocks' carnivorousness is now to be understood as feeding upon the frail surface people.
revisions.rationale: Underworld Meat Memory left the meat as an outside question supporting Morlocks are meat-eaters, but Horrible Realization About Meat gives shivering insight into what that meat might be, and Civilization Swept Into Oblivion identifies the replacement population as frail creatures, so the carnivorous claim now points to predation on the other human branch.

revisions.new_reading: The wood is now green and pleasant in morning light, approachable for fruit gathering, not black and forbidding.
revisions.rationale: Morning Fruit Foray shows the same wood under morning light as green and pleasant, changing the facts of Thick Wood Barrier's forbidding description.

revisions.new_reading: Frail Future People remain slight and frail and preyed upon, but are also still recognizably human whose form compels sympathy, so they cannot be regarded with detachment as mere cattle.
revisions.old_reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.
revisions.rationale: Inescapable Human Sympathy shows the attempt to see the Eloi as cattle collapses because their human form demands sympathy, adding a sympathetic-humanity layer to Frail Future People.

revisions.new_reading: Delicate Future People remain delicate Dresden-china pretty beings but are also still recognizably human whose form compels sympathy so they cannot be regarded with detachment as mere cattle.
revisions.old_reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the languor endpoint after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism, not only as directly enfeebled by security.
revisions.rationale: Delicate Future People refines Frail Future People, and Frail Future People now adds Inescapable Human Sympathy which defeats Eloi As Cattle detachment, so the delicate Dresden-china description must also carry that sympathetic-human block on cattle detachment in addition to its languor endpoint reading.

revisions.new_reading: His sustaining hope is renewed in conditional form: he now believes forcing the bronze doors with light may recover the Time Machine and allow escape.
revisions.rationale: The shattered hope account says his sustaining hope of escape was staggered, while the light entry escape belief lays out a plan to discover the Time Machine and escape, showing hope has returned.

revisions.new_reading: The hilltop immunity has ended; three pursuers now crouch in the black bushes behind the pair as night falls.
revisions.rationale: The earlier absence of attackers was true of that hill vigil, but the appearance of three crouching figures shows pursuers now closing in.

revisions.new_reading: The Thick Wood Barrier is again a black night wood that Armed flight into darkness enters and where Morlocks seize Traveller closes in.
revisions.old_reading: The wood is now green and pleasant in morning light, approachable for fruit gathering, not black and forbidding.
revisions.rationale: Thick Wood Barrier caused Open Hill Overnight Decision to avoid the dark wood, but Armed flight into darkness shows plunging into the black wood and Morlocks seize Traveller shows the wood is again black, forbidding and occupied, overturning the green pleasant morning reading.

revisions.new_reading: The Night Without Morlock Attack immunity has ended into active assault as Armed flight into darkness abandons the hill and Morlocks seize Traveller grabs coat and arm.
revisions.old_reading: The hilltop immunity has ended; three pursuers now crouch in the black bushes behind the pair as night falls.
revisions.rationale: Night Without Morlock Attack was caused by Open Hill Overnight Decision to stay on the open hill, but Armed flight into darkness shows that hill stay abandoned and Morlocks seize Traveller shows crouching watch escalated to physical seizure, so mere absence of attack no longer holds.

revisions.new_reading: The Long trek with Weena paused by Open Hill Overnight Decision has resumed as Armed flight into darkness carrying Weena into the wood and is now halted by Morlocks seize Traveller.
revisions.rationale: Open Hill Overnight Decision paused Long trek with Weena, but Armed flight into darkness shows carrying Weena again into the black wood while Morlocks seize Traveller shows that resumed carrying now caught by pursuers.

revisions.new_reading: Weena now lies beside the iron mace like one dead and cannot be revived.
revisions.rationale: The earlier motionless-Weena situation had her fainted but scarcely breathing; the present lifeless lying shows attempts to revive her now fail.

revisions.new_reading: The box of dry matches found in the chemistry gallery is now gone, lost while Morlocks cling to him.
revisions.rationale: The earlier dry-matches discovery established possession of the box; the present match-box loss shows it has vanished from his pocket.

revisions.new_reading: The iron bar hoped to force the bronze doors is also to be read as an effective melee weapon that can beat Morlocks back and fight free.
revisions.rationale: The earlier door-forcing plan valued the bar only for the bronze doors; the present counterattack shows the same lever used in hand-to-hand fighting.

revisions.new_reading: The protective blaze counted in Fire Against Morlocks can no longer use matches because the match-box is gone.
revisions.rationale: Fire Against Morlocks counts matches and camphor as means for a protective blaze, but Losing the match-box shows the box had gone while Dry matches discovery now records that box as lost, so the matches means no longer exists though the plan means the same.

revisions.new_reading: The encampment fire is no longer a controlled campfire but a raging forest fire advancing through the trees.
revisions.rationale: Decision to Encamp built a fire to encamp, now Forest Fire Realization shows that fire grown into an advancing burning forest.

revisions.new_reading: Weena is no longer beside the Traveller holding his hand; she has vanished amid the fire.
revisions.rationale: Weena Takes Hand had her standing beside him, now Weena Disappears has her gone when looked for.

revisions.new_reading: The fire made in Building smoky bonfire is no longer a controlled choking campfire but part of the raging forest fire advancing through the trees.
revisions.rationale: Decision to Encamp is now a raging forest fire rather than a controlled campfire, and Forest Fire Realization shows the flames of the burning forest advancing behind, so the fire built in Building smoky bonfire has changed in physical state while its original economizing purpose is unchanged.

revisions.new_reading: The Traveller is no longer holding Weena after the Armed exit with Weena, because she has vanished amid the fire.
revisions.rationale: Armed exit with Weena continued the protective contact begun in Weena Takes Hand, and Weena Disappears shows she was gone when looked for amid the fire, so the ongoing holding state no longer obtains while the past exit itself is unchanged.

revisions.new_reading: The protective blaze can still be made in limited form with loose matches and camphor, though the match-box is gone.
revisions.old_reading: The protective blaze counted in Fire Against Morlocks can no longer use matches because the match-box is gone.
revisions.rationale: Loose Matches Discovery shows matches still held, against the earlier view that the protective blaze could no longer use matches because the box was gone.

revisions.new_reading: Slight beautiful graceful frail beings are also to be understood as living a pleasant heedless cattle-like existence ending as prey.
revisions.old_reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.
revisions.rationale: Eloi as Unwary Cattle identifies beauty with pleasant heedless cattle existence ending as prey, deepening the picture of slight beautiful frail beings enfeebled by security.

revisions.new_reading: Massive splendid buildings are also to be read as relics of an intellect that destroyed itself by pursuing comfort, ease and a permanent secure balanced society.
revisions.old_reading: Massive splendid buildings remain seen, but they no longer signify vastly superior inhabitants; childlike frail people show architectural splendour can coexist with intellectual decline.
revisions.rationale: Comfort-Seeking Intellectual Suicide explains decline through comfort-seeking permanency, adding cause for splendid architecture coexisting with frail minds.

revisions.new_reading: Delicate Future People are also to be understood as living a pleasant heedless cattle-like existence ending as prey.
revisions.old_reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the languor endpoint after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism, not only as directly enfeebled by security.
revisions.rationale: Delicate Future People refines Frail Future People, so the new cattle-like understanding of Frail Future People applies to the Dresden-china description, as stated in Eloi as Unwary Cattle.

revisions.new_reading: Pain and necessity are no longer finally broken everywhere; after thousands of years necessity has returned below.
revisions.rationale: Necessity Returns Below states Mother Necessity returned below when feeding became disjointed, so Broken Grindstone of Necessity no longer holds everywhere.

revisions.new_reading: The bronze pedestal valves now stand open.
revisions.old_reading: The bronze pedestal remains closed, but a coil in its decoration is now flattened and verdigris has come off in powdery flakes from hammering.
revisions.rationale: The valves were found open, so the pedestal can no longer be treated as remaining closed.

revisions.new_reading: The Time Machine is no longer missing from the lawn but is recovered waiting inside the Sphinx.
revisions.rationale: The machine found inside shows the disappearance from the lawn has ended.

revisions.new_reading: The night with no Morlocks on the hill should now also be understood as deliberate holding back as part of a baiting trap, not mere absence.
revisions.rationale: The belief that the Morlocks are baiting him gives the earlier quiet night a new significance as luring.

revisions.new_reading: The bronze pedestal is now slammed shut with the Traveller sealed in darkness inside.
revisions.old_reading: The bronze pedestal valves now stand open.
revisions.rationale: Panels first found open then slammed shut, so the pedestal is now sealed with the Traveller inside in darkness.

revisions.new_reading: The loose matches in the trouser pocket should now also be understood as strike-on-box kind effectively useless without the box.
revisions.rationale: The loose matches remain in the pocket but their significance changes to useless without the box.

revisions.new_reading: The Full-size Time Machine is no longer vanished from the lawn but recovered waiting inside the Sphinx as shown by Recovered Time Machine Inside.
revisions.old_reading: The Full-size Time Machine is no longer lying on the lawn by the Sphinx; it has vanished.
revisions.rationale: Time Machine Vanished now ends in Recovered Time Machine Inside waiting in the Sphinx, so the same machine described by Full-size Time Machine has moved from absent to present without changing what it is.

revisions.new_reading: Losing the match-box is now a total loss of fire-making power because Useless Matches Crisis makes Loose Matches Discovery unusable without the box.
revisions.rationale: Loose Matches Discovery once made Losing the match-box seem partial, but Useless Matches Crisis shows those loose matches light only on the lost box, turning the loss into total helplessness.

revisions.new_reading: Fire Against Morlocks protection is now unavailable because Useless Matches Crisis leaves Loose Matches Discovery unlightable without the box.
revisions.old_reading: The protective blaze can still be made in limited form with loose matches and camphor, though the match-box is gone.
revisions.rationale: Loose Matches Discovery once supported Fire Against Morlocks in limited form, but Useless Matches Crisis shows those matches need the lost box, so the defence can no longer be used.

revisions.new_reading: The starting levers are no longer removed and safekept; they have been fixed back onto the machine and pulled for escape.
revisions.rationale: The passage shows the disabled condition being undone when the lever is fixed and used, changing present facts while leaving the earlier removal true of its own time.

revisions.new_reading: The dials no longer stand at 802,701; they are spinning rapidly onward into far deeper futurity.
revisions.rationale: The spinning thousands hand shows the earlier recorded date has been surpassed, changing the present dial reading while leaving the earlier reading true of its time.

revisions.new_reading: The sun is now huge, red and motionless on the horizon, beyond merely being hotter than in the traveller's own time.
revisions.rationale: Vast forward travel carries the sun past the hotter stage to a red halted stage, changing what is now the case while the hotter description stays true of its earlier age.

revisions.new_reading: The time machine is no longer at 802,701 but has been carried far onward into deeper futurity.
revisions.old_reading: The Large unfinished time machine is no longer waiting in the future garden with levers removed but has vanished from the lawn by the Sphinx with the Full-size Time Machine as shown by Time Machine Vanished.
revisions.rationale: Machine's Far Future Date no longer stands at 802,701 because Rush Into Deep Futurity shows the thousands hand sweeping onward, carrying the Large unfinished time machine beyond its prior date.

revisions.new_reading: The day-night flicker no longer merges into continuous greyness but has halted entirely with the sun motionless on the horizon.
revisions.old_reading: The alternating black night and bright day no longer flickers distinctly but has merged into one continuous greyness with a deep blue sky at higher speed.
revisions.rationale: Merged Continuous Greyness had turned Accelerating Day-Night Flicker into continuous greyness, but Motionless Red Sun shows the sun stopped and halted motionless, ending the alternation altogether.

revisions.new_reading: The sun no longer hops across the sky; it hangs huge, red and motionless on the horizon.
revisions.rationale: The new beach view shows a motionless sun, ending the earlier hopping regime.

revisions.new_reading: The machine is no longer overturned on soft turf; it now stands on a sloping beach beside a windless sea in the far future.
revisions.rationale: The new beach account gives the machine's present whereabouts after further travel.

revisions.new_reading: The Traveller is no longer in the Hail Beaten Garden Lawn but now stands with his machine on the Sloping Salt-Edged Beach.
revisions.rationale: The Hail Beaten Garden Lawn specifies the place of Stunned Turf Landing, and Stunned Turf Landing is now revised to the machine standing on the Sloping Salt-Edged Beach, so the garden sojourn is left in the past while the meaning is the same.

revisions.new_reading: The Unpleasant Headlong Sensation has now ceased entirely with the machine at rest on the Sloping Salt-Edged Beach under the Motionless Red Sun Sky.
revisions.old_reading: The helpless unpleasant headlong feeling has faded and merged into hysterical exhilaration as the rush into futurity continues.
revisions.rationale: The Unpleasant Headlong Sensation described ongoing helpless motion, but Stunned Turf Landing now places the machine at rest on the Sloping Salt-Edged Beach under the Motionless Red Sun Sky, so the motion fact has ended while the meaning is unchanged.

revisions.new_reading: The huge red motionless sun is now even larger and duller after thousand-year forward strides.
revisions.rationale: This passage's sun watching describes the sun growing larger and duller in the westward sky during the onward journey, updating the earlier image of the huge red motionless sun.

revisions.new_reading: By more than thirty million years on the monstrous crabs are gone and the red beach is lifeless and flecked with white.
revisions.rationale: This passage's lifeless snow situation says the crawling multitude of crabs had disappeared, changing the earlier presence of the monstrous crab creature from a current threat to a past phase.

revisions.new_reading: The split sky persists but its motionless red sun is now even larger and duller.
revisions.rationale: Motionless Red Sun Sky refines Motionless Red Sun, and Millennia-Long Sun Watching shows that same sun growing larger and duller, so the sky's sun has changed in fact but not in meaning.

revisions.new_reading: The sun is now even larger and duller with snow beginning, far beyond merely being hotter.
revisions.old_reading: The sun is now huge, red and motionless on the horizon, beyond merely being hotter than in the traveller's own time.
revisions.rationale: Hotter Sun Fact tracks a sun already become huge red and motionless, and Motionless Red Sun with Millennia-Long Sun Watching shows it growing even larger and duller while Crabs Gone Lifeless Snow shows cooling to snow.

revisions.new_reading: The far-future shore is now motionless without crabs or other animal movement; only green slime shows life persists.
revisions.rationale: Motionless lifeless world shows the crab-covered desolation described in Abominable Desolate World has passed into lifeless stillness.

revisions.new_reading: The huge motionless red sun is now being covered by an eclipse, bringing deepening freezing darkness.
revisions.old_reading: The split sky persists but its motionless red sun is now even larger and duller.
revisions.rationale: Eclipse over sun shows the previously visible motionless red sun described in Motionless Red Sun Sky is now obscured.

revisions.new_reading: The Motionless Red Sun is now obscured by the Eclipse over sun bringing deepening freezing darkness.
revisions.old_reading: The huge red motionless sun is now even larger and duller after thousand-year forward strides.
revisions.rationale: Motionless Red Sun Sky is now covered by Eclipse over sun, so the Motionless Red Sun described as huge red and motionless is now darkened and eclipsed while remaining the same sun.

revisions.new_reading: The Vast New Moon Line is no longer visible now that the Eclipse over sun has deepened into absolute darkness where Pale stars alone remain.
revisions.rationale: Motionless Red Sun Sky has darkened through Eclipse over sun into absolute darkness where Pale stars alone are visible, so the Vast New Moon Line can no longer be seen though what it was remains the same.

revisions.new_reading: The Motionless Red Sun is no longer fully obscured by eclipse darkness; its edge has reappeared as a red-hot bow.
revisions.old_reading: The Motionless Red Sun is now obscured by the Eclipse over sun bringing deepening freezing darkness.
revisions.rationale: The Red-hot solar edge shows the sun returning after darkness, so the obscured state described for the Motionless Red Sun no longer holds.

revisions.new_reading: The sky is no longer split between black starry darkness and red glow with motionless sun; during backward travel the blinking succession of days and nights has resumed with golden sun and blue sky.
revisions.old_reading: The huge motionless red sun is now being covered by an eclipse, bringing deepening freezing darkness.
revisions.rationale: The Backward flight through time shows the Traveller has left the far-future stillness, so the still split-sky state described for the Motionless Red Sun Sky no longer holds.

revisions.new_reading: The sun is hopping and blinking again with golden sun and blue sky during backward travel.
revisions.old_reading: The sun no longer hops across the sky; it hangs huge, red and motionless on the horizon.
revisions.rationale: Motionless Red Sun Sky held that hopping had ceased into motionless red stillness, but Backward flight through time resumes the blinking succession of days and nights with golden sun and blue sky.

revisions.new_reading: Darkness is no longer absolute with only pale stars because the sun's edge has reappeared.
revisions.rationale: Pale stars alone followed Eclipse over sun, but Red-hot solar edge shows the edge of the sun reappearing like a red-hot bow which ends that obscuration.

revisions.new_reading: The large machine is back in the laboratory after its far journey, resting in the north-west against the wall where seen.
revisions.old_reading: The time machine is no longer at 802,701 but has been carried far onward into deeper futurity.
revisions.rationale: The Displaced Machine Evidence says it started south-east and now rests north-west, while the Large unfinished time machine was revealed as nearly finished in the laboratory; it has now returned but in a different corner.

revisions.new_reading: The no-interruptions telling bargain is over; the audience is now invited to judge the tale as a story.
revisions.rationale: The Asking for Story Verdict invites judgment as a story, while the No Interruptions Rule required refraining from interruptions in order to hear it; the telling is finished so the ban no longer applies.

revisions.new_reading: The Full-size Time Machine is now back in the laboratory resting in the north-west after its far journey.
revisions.old_reading: The Full-size Time Machine is no longer vanished from the lawn but recovered waiting inside the Sphinx as shown by Recovered Time Machine Inside.
revisions.rationale: The Large unfinished time machine is now back in the laboratory after its far journey, as proved by Displaced Machine Evidence, so the Full-size Time Machine is no longer waiting inside the Sphinx but has returned to the laboratory.

revisions.new_reading: The comfortable gathering is now restless and silent after hearing the long story, with chairs creaking.
revisions.old_reading: The gathering has left the dinner table and adjourned to the smoking-room to hear the long story.
revisions.rationale: Restless sceptical audience shows the relaxed listening posture has given way to sceptical restlessness.

revisions.new_reading: The gashed bleeding knuckles are now half-healed scars examined after the story.
revisions.old_reading: He is no longer in gashed-knuckle frenzy but awake in morning freshness and able to face his situation rationally.
revisions.rationale: Scarred knuckles evidence shows the bush-beating wounds have partly healed by the time of telling.

revisions.new_reading: The Time Traveller has finished telling his long story and now faces the Restless sceptical audience after the Comfortable after-dinner gathering turned restless and silent.
revisions.old_reading: The Time Traveller has finished Ravenous dinner return and completed Adjourn to smoking-room where Comfortable after-dinner gathering now waits for his long story.
revisions.rationale: The Time Traveller previously waited to tell his story within the Comfortable after-dinner gathering, but the Restless sceptical audience shows that gathering has become restless and silent after the telling, while Editor dismisses tale marks the sceptical posture he now confronts.

revisions.new_reading: The Withered White Flowers are now not only silent tokens but contested proof the Traveller appeals to in mute inquiry and refuses to surrender amid the Restless sceptical audience and Editor dismisses tale.
revisions.rationale: Placing of the Withered White Flowers once supported True Despite Lying, but with that claim now opposed by Editor dismisses tale and the audience become the Restless sceptical audience, the gaze captured in Withered white flowers and the withholding in Refusal to give flowers show the flowers re-understood as evidence the Traveller clings to.

revisions.new_reading: The comfortable gathering has now broken up for the night with laughter, an overwork explanation, and the Traveller left shouting good-night from the doorway.
revisions.old_reading: The comfortable gathering is now restless and silent after hearing the long story, with chairs creaking.
revisions.rationale: Laughing midnight farewell shows the seated gathering dispersing, so the earlier gathering is over.

revisions.new_reading: The Restless sceptical audience has now broken up and departed with laughter in the Laughing midnight farewell.
revisions.rationale: The Restless sceptical audience described post-story restlessness, but the Laughing midnight farewell shows the party breaking up with laughter and good-night shouting, ending the Comfortable after-dinner gathering, so the restless gathering no longer sits together.

revisions.new_reading: The Guests On Alert Watching group has now dispersed for the night with the Laughing midnight farewell.
revisions.old_reading: The Guests On Alert Watching group has followed in the Guided Laboratory Visit by lamplight into the laboratory to behold the Full-size Time Machine while still puzzled and incredulous.
revisions.rationale: The Guests On Alert Watching group had continued into watching and laboratory visits, but the Laughing midnight farewell ends the Comfortable after-dinner gathering with departure, so the watching group no longer remains assembled.

revisions.new_reading: The Time Traveller has now checked the Solid travel-stained machine, reaffirmed his story in Story affirmed as true, and been left shouting good-night in the Laughing midnight farewell.
revisions.old_reading: The Time Traveller has finished telling his long story and now faces the Restless sceptical audience after the Comfortable after-dinner gathering turned restless and silent.
revisions.rationale: The Time Traveller previously faced the Restless sceptical audience after the Comfortable after-dinner gathering turned restless, but the Lamp-lit dash to corridor and Solid travel-stained machine restore certainty in Story affirmed as true before the Laughing midnight farewell disperses the audience.

revisions.new_reading: The Full-size Time Machine is no longer resting in the laboratory; it has vanished with the Time Traveller.
revisions.old_reading: The Full-size Time Machine is now back in the laboratory resting in the north-west after its far journey.
revisions.rationale: The earlier situation placed the large machine back in the laboratory, but the vanishing shows the laboratory empty of the Traveller, meaning that placement no longer holds.

revisions.new_reading: The Withered White Flowers are also to be read as enduring witness that gratitude and tenderness survived in man, in addition to being silent tokens and contested proof.
revisions.old_reading: The Withered White Flowers are now not only silent tokens but contested proof the Traveller appeals to in mute inquiry and refuses to surrender amid the Restless sceptical audience and Editor dismisses tale.
revisions.rationale: The earlier placing left the flowers as silent tokens later gazed on with mute inquiry, while the closing witness explicitly makes the shrivelled flowers stand for surviving gratitude and tenderness.

revisions.new_reading: The Large unfinished time machine is no longer resting in the laboratory but has vanished with the Time Traveller.
revisions.old_reading: The large machine is back in the laboratory after its far journey, resting in the north-west against the wall where seen.
revisions.rationale: The recorded rest of Large unfinished time machine in the laboratory cannot still hold because Full-size Time Machine has vanished with the Traveller and Traveller's Abrupt Vanishing finds the laboratory empty of the Traveller.

units.content: The passage presents the Time Traveller as an animated speaker expounding a difficult subject to his listeners.
units.label: The Time Traveller
units.reading: The Time Traveller remains an animated speaker but is now also understood through Too Clever Distrust as too clever, reserved and whimsical to be taken at face value.
units.state: The Time Traveller has now checked the Solid travel-stained machine, reaffirmed his story in Story affirmed as true, and been left shouting good-night in the Laughing midnight farewell.

units.content: The listeners sit comfortably in the inventor's patented chairs in a warm relaxed setting.
units.label: Comfortable after-dinner gathering
units.state: The comfortable gathering has now broken up for the night with laughter, an overwork explanation, and the Traveller left shouting good-night from the doorway.

units.content: The Time Traveller asserts that the geometry taught in school rests on a misconception.
units.label: School geometry is misconceived

units.content: Mathematical lines and planes are mere abstractions with no real existence.
units.label: Mathematical abstractions lack existence

units.content: The Time Traveller challenges Filby by asking whether an instantaneous cube could really exist.
units.label: Instantaneous cube cannot exist

units.content: Any real body must have extension in Length, Breadth, Thickness, and Duration.
units.label: Fourfold bodily extension

units.content: Human consciousness moves intermittently in one direction along Time from beginning to end of life.
units.label: Consciousness moving through Time

units.content: The Fourth Dimension is only another way of looking at Time.
units.label: Fourth Dimension as Time

units.content: The Provincial Mayor admits he has not heard talk about the Fourth Dimension.
units.label: Uninformed Provincial Mayor
units.state: The Provincial Mayor is no longer simply uninformed; he now briefly brightens as if he grasps the fourth-dimension idea.

units.content: Some philosophical people posit another direction at right angles to the three to construct Four-Dimensional geometry.
units.label: Philosophical four-dimensional geometry

units.content: The Provincial Mayor briefly brightens as if grasping the fourth-dimension idea.
units.label: Mayor's Transitory Understanding

units.content: Successive age-portraits are three-dimensional sections of a fixed, unalterable four-dimensional being.
units.label: Portraits as Time Sections

units.content: Time is only a kind of Space, as shown by a barometer trace moving along no recognized spatial dimension.
units.label: Time as Kind of Space

units.content: If Time is a spatial dimension, the Medical Man asks why it is regarded differently and cannot be traveled in.
units.label: Objection on Moving in Time

units.content: Humans move freely in two dimensions but gravitation limits free movement up and down.
units.label: Gravity Limits Vertical Movement

units.content: Before balloons humans had essentially no freedom of vertical movement.
units.label: No vertical freedom before balloons

units.content: Human existence drifts with uniform velocity from cradle to grave like falling from a height.
units.label: Humans drift through Time

units.content: Vividly recalling an incident is presented as briefly jumping back to its instant.
units.label: Memory as backward time jump

units.content: The Traveller suggests humans might turn about and travel the other way in Time.
units.label: Hope to reverse Time drift

units.content: Filby objects that the idea is against reason, prompting the Traveller to ask what reason.
units.label: Filby calls idea unreasonable

units.content: The Time Traveller proposes a machine that can be driven indifferently in any direction of Space and Time.
units.label: Steerable Space-Time Machine

units.content: The Time Traveller asserts that he has experimental verification of his theory.
units.label: Claim of Experimental Verification

units.content: The guests amusedly imagine convenient historical, classical, and financial uses for time travel.
units.label: Skeptical Amused Speculation

units.content: Filby remains unconvinced and responds to the theory with laughter.
units.label: Filby the Incredulous Skeptic
units.state: Filby is no longer laughing dismissively; he is astonished and swearing after witnessing the vanishing.

units.content: The smiling Time Traveller walks out of the room toward his laboratory to produce the experiment.
units.label: Traveller Fetches Experiment
units.state: He has now come back from the laboratory into the room and is present again with the guests.

units.content: The Time Traveller comes back before Filby finishes his preface.
units.label: Traveller Returns Interrupting Filby

units.content: The Time Traveller holds a glittering metallic object in his hand.
units.label: Glittering Metallic Model
units.state: The glittering metallic object is no longer held or present; it has vanished, leaving the table bare except for the lamp.

units.content: All the guests are on alert as they watch the demonstration.
units.label: Guests On Alert Watching
units.state: The Guests On Alert Watching group has now dispersed for the night with the Laughing midnight farewell.

units.content: The little affair is his plan for a machine to travel through time.
units.label: Model For Time Travel

units.content: A bar of the model has a twinkling appearance as though unreal in some way.
units.label: Twinkling Unreal Bar

units.content: The Time Traveller explains that one lever sends the machine into the future and the other reverses it.
units.label: Levers Control Time Direction

units.content: The Time Traveller says he does not want to waste the model and then be called a quack.
units.label: Fear Of Being Called Quack

units.content: The Psychologist himself presses the lever and sends the model Time Machine on its voyage.
units.label: Psychologist Launches Model

units.content: The little machine becomes ghostly and vanishes, leaving the table bare except for the lamp.
units.label: Model Vanishes Into Future
units.reading: The vanishing is now understood as rapid travel diluting presentation below visibility, like an unseen spoke or bullet, not simply disappearing.

units.content: The guests fall silent for a minute, then Filby swears in astonishment.
units.label: Stunned Silent Reaction
units.state: The Stunned Silent Reaction of silent astonishment has ended into Guests question time travel with guests staring and demanding debate over past versus future.

units.content: The guests stare at each other and demand whether the machine really travelled in time.
units.label: Guests question time travel
units.reading: The questioning is now understood as rooted in long-standing distrust of a man seen as too clever, reserved and whimsical to take at face value, not only momentary astonishment at the vanishing.

units.content: The Time Traveller reveals a nearly finished big machine in the laboratory for his own journey.
units.label: Large unfinished time machine
units.state: The Large unfinished time machine is no longer resting in the laboratory but has vanished with the Time Traveller.

units.content: The Psychologist claims the model must have gone into the past if it went anywhere.
units.label: Past travel inference

units.content: A machine travelling into the future without moving in space would still be visible here through the intervening time.
units.label: Future travel would persist

units.content: Rapid time travel dilutes the machine's impression below the threshold of visibility.
units.label: Diluted presentation invisibility

units.content: The invisible machine is likened to an unseen spinning spoke or flying bullet.
units.label: Spinning spoke bullet analogy

units.content: The laboratory contains a larger, generally complete version of the vanished little mechanism made with nickel, ivory, and crystal.
units.label: Full-size Time Machine
units.state: The Full-size Time Machine is no longer resting in the laboratory; it has vanished with the Time Traveller.

units.content: The Time Traveller leads the puzzled but incredulous guests by lamplight down the corridor to his laboratory.
units.label: Guided Laboratory Visit

units.content: The Medical Man cautions that the story sounds plausible at night but should await the common sense of the morning.
units.label: Morning Common Sense

units.content: The Time Traveller solemnly insists he is perfectly serious about intending to explore time on the machine.
units.label: Serious Time Exploration

units.content: The guests distrust the Time Traveller because his cleverness, reserve, and whim make him seem unlike a straightforward believable man.
units.label: Too Clever Distrust

units.content: The narrator arrives late to Richmond to find the other guests already assembled.
units.label: Late arrival to gathering

units.content: The absent host leaves a note asking the Medical Man to start dinner at seven without him.
units.label: Note ordering dinner start

units.content: The previous week’s demonstration is now framed as an ingenious paradox and trick.
units.label: Dismissive trick retelling

units.content: The Time Traveller suddenly stands before the diners, prompting a cry of surprise.
units.label: Sudden doorway appearance

units.content: The whole table turns toward the door in alarm at the Time Traveller’s distressed appearance.
units.label: Alarmed table reaction

units.content: The Time Traveller appears dusty, dirty, pale, cut, haggard, and limping.
units.label: Battered traveller appearance
units.state: He has now washed and changed into ordinary evening clothes, with nothing of his dusty, dirty, cut condition remaining save his haggard look.

units.content: The guests stare in silence at the figure in the doorway, expecting him to speak.
units.label: Silent staring guests

units.content: He wordlessly drinks champagne in draughts and visibly begins to revive.
units.label: Champagne revival draught

units.content: A flicker of his former smile briefly crosses his suffering face.
units.label: Ghost of old smile

units.content: He defers questions, promising to explain after washing while begging meat as starving.
units.label: Promised explanation after washing

units.content: The Time Traveller leaves wearing only tattered, blood-stained socks on his injured feet.
units.label: Blood-Stained Socks

units.content: The Editor sensationalizes the Traveller's strange behaviour as newspaper headline material.
units.label: Editor Headlines Behaviour

units.content: The narrator assures the guests that the business of the Time Machine explains the Traveller's state.
units.label: Time Machine Explanation

units.content: The Editor argues that rolling in a paradox could not cover a man with dust.
units.label: Ridicule of Time Travel

units.content: The Time Traveller returns in ordinary evening clothes with only his haggard look remaining.
units.label: Traveller Returns Haggard

units.content: The Time Traveller sits down starving and delights in eating meat before speaking.
units.label: Ravenous dinner return

units.content: The Time Traveller answers yes when asked if he has been time travelling.
units.label: Confirmation of time travel

units.content: The dinner grows uncomfortable as curious guests watch the Time Traveller eat.
units.label: Tense uncomfortable dinner

units.content: The Editor treats the claimed adventure as sensational copy to be bought.
units.label: Editor's commercial mockery

units.content: After eating, the Time Traveller leads the guests to the adjoining room to tell his long story.
units.label: Adjourn to smoking-room

units.content: The Time Traveller will tell what happened to him only if the listeners agree to refrain from interruptions.
units.label: No Interruptions Rule
units.state: The no-interruptions telling bargain is over; the audience is now invited to judge the tale as a story.

units.content: Most of the Time Traveller's story will sound like lying but is true in every word.
units.label: True Despite Lying

units.content: Since four o'clock in his laboratory the Time Traveller has lived eight unprecedented days.
units.label: Eight Days Lived

units.content: The hearers sit mostly in shadow in the unlit smoking-room while attention fixes on the Time Traveller's face.
units.label: Shadowed Smoking-Room Audience

units.content: The narrator feels keenly that pen, ink, and himself are inadequate to express the quality of the live telling.
units.label: Inadequacy Of Retelling

units.content: The completed Time Machine stands before them visibly travel-worn with cracked ivory and bent brass.
units.label: Worn Completed Machine

units.content: He compares his wonder before starting to a suicide holding a pistol to his skull.
units.label: Suicide Wonder Simile

units.content: He pulls the starting lever and almost immediately the stopping lever for a first trial displacement.
units.label: First Start-Stop Hop

units.content: The laboratory clock has jumped from just past ten to nearly half-past three.
units.label: Clock Jump Confirms Travel

units.content: Mrs. Watchett walks toward the garden door apparently without seeing him in the machine.
units.label: Unseen Housekeeper Crossing

units.content: Night and day now alternate black and bright ever faster as he accelerates.
units.label: Accelerating Day-Night Flicker
units.state: The day-night flicker no longer merges into continuous greyness but has halted entirely with the sun motionless on the horizon.

units.content: Time travelling feels excessively unpleasant, like helpless headlong motion on a switchback with dread of a smash.
units.label: Unpleasant Headlong Sensation
units.state: The Unpleasant Headlong Sensation has now ceased entirely with the machine at rest on the Sloping Salt-Edged Beach under the Motionless Red Sun Sky.

units.content: As he gains pace, night follows day like the flapping of a black wing.
units.label: Night Day Flapping Wing

units.content: The sun hops swiftly across the sky, leaping it every minute with each minute marking a day.
units.label: Sun Hopping Daily Leap
units.state: The sun is hopping and blinking again with golden sun and blue sky during backward travel.

units.content: Faster still, the palpitation of night and day merges into one continuous greyness and deep blue sky.
units.label: Merged Continuous Greyness

units.content: The landscape around the hillside appears misty and vague as time rushes past.
units.label: Misty Vague Landscape

units.content: His pace accelerates to over a year per minute, marked by flashing snow and brief spring green.
units.label: Year A Minute Pace

units.content: Initial discomfort fades into hysterical exhilaration and confused madness as he rushes into futurity.
units.label: Exhilarated Confused Flight
units.state: The hysterical exhilarated rush into futurity has now ended in a stunned stop on soft turf.

units.content: He glimpses massive mist-like splendid buildings and evergreen earth suggesting wonderful future advances.
units.label: Glimmering Future Architecture
units.other_readings_json: ["The massive splendid buildings are understood as themselves worn and dilapidated, not merely coexisting with decline but physically decaying.", "Glimmering Future Architecture is now also to be read as relics of the civilising climax left to decay after security enfeebled their maintainers.", "Glimmering Future Architecture is now also to be read as grandeur built by perfect conquest and left to ruin by contented inactivity.", "Massive splendid buildings are also to be read as relics of an intellect that destroyed itself by pursuing comfort, ease and a permanent secure balanced society."]
units.reading: Massive splendid buildings remain seen, but they no longer signify vastly superior inhabitants; childlike frail people show architectural splendour can coexist with intellectual decline.

units.content: Stopping risks jamming his molecules into intervening matter and causing a far-reaching explosive reaction.
units.label: Deadly Stopping Collision Risk

units.content: Prolonged strangeness, swaying, and sensation of falling have completely upset his nerves.
units.label: Nerves Upset By Strangeness

units.content: In petulant impatience he yanks the lever, topples the machine, and is flung headlong through the air.
units.label: Impatient Lever Pull Ejection

units.content: The Traveller lands stunned on soft turf beside his overturned machine amid hissing hail.
units.label: Stunned Turf Landing
units.state: The machine is no longer overturned on soft turf; it now stands on a sloping beach beside a windless sea in the far future.

units.content: He finds himself in a garden where rhododendron bushes shed blossoms under the hail.
units.label: Hail Beaten Garden Lawn
units.state: The Traveller is no longer in the Hail Beaten Garden Lawn but now stands with his machine on the Sloping Salt-Edged Beach.

units.content: A huge white marble winged sphinx-like figure on a bronze pedestal looms over the garden.
units.label: Colossal White Winged Statue
units.other_readings_json: ["The bronze base beneath the looming white figure is also to be understood as a hollow container with door-like panels that can hide the machine, in addition to being a mocking watcher."]
units.reading: The Colossal White Winged Statue is now understood as a mocking triumphant watcher hinting at hostile intervention like the Smiling Marble Sphinx Watcher and Mocking sphinx smile, not merely a neutral looming monument.

units.content: The statue's weather-worn condition gives an unpleasant suggestion of disease.
units.label: Weather-Worn Diseased Omen

units.content: The hail curtain thins and the sky lightens with the promise of sun.
units.label: Clearing Hail Sunlight Promise
units.state: The hailstorm has now been swept aside and vanished, with sunlight breaking through.

units.content: The Traveller fears future men may have become cruel, inhuman, and overwhelmingly powerful.
units.label: Future humanity turned cruel
units.other_readings_json: ["The fear that Future humanity turned cruel can no longer be dismissed as misplaced from surface frailty alone now that Humanity Split Species leaves a second underground branch still to be judged."]
units.reading: Future humanity turned cruel is now to be read as no longer dismissible as misplaced because the overwhelming threat may reside in the subterranean second branch rather than the frail surface people.

units.content: Seized by panic at the vast buildings, he frantically tries to readjust the Time Machine.
units.label: Panicked attempt to escape

units.content: The grey storm downpour vanishes like a ghost's trailing garments as sunlight breaks through.
units.label: Storm vanishes like ghost

units.content: He feels exposed and prey-like, as a bird knowing a hawk is above and will swoop.
units.label: Naked prey vulnerability
units.state: He no longer feels exposed and prey-like; the fearless bearing of the small creature has restored his confidence.

units.content: With retreat secured and courage recovered, he sees robed figures watching him from high in a nearby house.
units.label: First sight of watchers
units.reading: First sight of watchers is now a first glimpse of the same frail Watching Uniform Diners peering from already worn and dilapidated houses, not powerful overseers in intact splendour.

units.content: A group of running small men approaches the Traveller from the bushes by the White Sphinx.
units.label: Small Men Approach

units.content: The future people are slight, beautiful, graceful, and indescribably frail beings.
units.label: Frail Future People
units.other_readings_json: ["Frail future people are now also to be read as the end-point after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism and then sank into languor, not only as direct enfeeblement by security.", "The Frail Future People are now to be read as only the surface branch of a humanity split into two species, still frail from security but no longer the whole of humanity.", "The slight beautiful frail people are now also to be understood as descendants of the Capitalist upper branch maintained by underground labour, in addition to being enfeebled by security.", "The slight beautiful frail beings should now also be understood as decaying doomed prey whose former servants are creeping on as their nemesis in a reversed class order.", "Frail Future People remain slight and frail and preyed upon, but are also still recognizably human whose form compels sympathy, so they cannot be regarded with detachment as mere cattle.", "Slight beautiful graceful frail beings are also to be understood as living a pleasant heedless cattle-like existence ending as prey."]
units.reading: Frail Future People are now also to be read as enfeebled by perfect security which rewarded feebleness.

units.content: The creature's complete lack of fear strikes the Traveller and restores his confidence.
units.label: Fearlessness Restores Confidence

units.content: The small people touch the Traveller's hands, back, and shoulders to make sure he is real.
units.label: Tactile Reality Check

units.content: The Traveller unscrews the starting levers from the Time Machine to keep the visitors from setting it in motion.
units.label: Removing Machine Levers
units.state: The starting levers are no longer removed and safekept; they have been fixed back onto the machine and pulled for escape.

units.content: The future people have a delicate Dresden-china prettiness with small, childlike features and large mild eyes.
units.label: Delicate Future People
units.other_readings_json: ["The delicate Dresden-china people are only the surface branch of a humanity now split into two distinct species, still showing enfeeblement after security but no longer taken as the whole of humanity.", "Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the Capitalist-descended surface branch maintained by hidden underground labour while remaining the languor endpoint.", "The Delicate Future People are now also to be understood as decaying doomed prey whose former servants are creeping on as their nemesis.", "Delicate Future People remain delicate Dresden-china pretty beings but are also still recognizably human whose form compels sympathy so they cannot be regarded with detachment as mere cattle.", "Delicate Future People are also to be understood as living a pleasant heedless cattle-like existence ending as prey."]
units.reading: Delicate Future People are now also to be read as the languor endpoint after secure energy burned briefly in art and eroticism, not only as directly enfeebled by security.

units.content: The future people surround the Traveller smiling and cooing to each other without attempting to communicate with him.
units.label: Passive Cooing Onlookers

units.content: When the Traveller points to the sun, a little figure copies the gesture and astonishes him by imitating thunder.
units.label: Sun Gesture Thunder Mimicry

units.content: The Traveller had always expected the people of 802,000 to be vastly ahead in knowledge, art, and everything.
units.label: Expected Future Superiority
units.reading: Expected Future Superiority should now be understood as a naive absurd assumption about inevitable progress, not as a reasonable forecast.

units.content: One of the creatures asks if the Traveller came from the sun in a thunderstorm, showing five-year-old intellect.
units.label: Childlike Sun Thunder Question
units.reading: Childlike Sun Thunder Question is now also to be read as illustration that Victorian restless energy become weakness left only childlike intellect.

units.content: The Traveller is flooded with disappointment and feels for a moment that he built the Time Machine in vain.
units.label: Time Machine Built Vain
units.reading: Time Machine Built Vain should now be understood as disappointment caused by the collapse of Expected Future Superiority now exposed as Absurd future progress assumption.

units.content: The Traveller mimes a thunderclap and the little people withdraw and bow.
units.label: Thunderclap Mime Startles Crowd

units.content: The crowd laughingly runs for flowers and piles blossoms on the Traveller.
units.label: Flower Garland Smothering

units.content: A white marble sphinx seems to watch the Traveller with a smile at his astonishment.
units.label: Smiling Marble Sphinx Watcher
units.reading: The watching smile should now be understood as mocking triumph hinting at hostile intervention, not merely curious watching at astonishment.

units.content: The Traveller recalls his confident expectation of a grave intellectual posterity with irresistible merriment.
units.label: Mocked Intellectual Posterity Hope

units.content: The world beyond the crowd is a long-neglected yet weedless tangle of beautiful bushes and flowers.
units.label: Weedless Neglected Future Garden
units.reading: Weedless Neglected Future Garden is now also to be read as subjugated nature staying weedless combined with neglect from enfeebled maintainers.

units.content: The big doorway opens into a huge hall hung with brown and lit by tempered coloured-glass light.
units.label: Vast Brown-Hung Hall

units.content: The hall floor of huge hard white-metal blocks is deeply channelled by the traffic of past generations.
units.label: Worn White-Metal Floor

units.content: The conductors and Traveller sit on cushions and eat fruit by hand, tossing peel and stalks into table openings.
units.label: Hand-Eaten Fruit Meal

units.content: The hall's dilapidated look is what strikes the narrator most.
units.label: Dilapidated Look Strikes

units.content: About two hundred identical soft silky-clad diners crowd near and watch the Traveller with shining little eyes.
units.label: Watching Uniform Diners

units.content: The remote future people live entirely on fruit, forcing the narrator to become frugivorous too.
units.label: All-fruit vegetarian diet

units.content: Common domestic animals have died out in this future world.
units.label: Domestic animals extinct

units.content: A floury fruit in a three-sided husk becomes the narrator's staple food.
units.label: Floury husk staple fruit

units.content: The narrator starts learning their speech by holding up fruits and using interrogative sounds and gestures.
units.label: Learning language from fruit

units.content: The little people are extremely indolent and easily fatigued by his interrogations.
units.label: Indolent easily fatigued people

units.content: The little hosts approach with eager astonishment but soon wander away like children.
units.label: Hosts' Fleeting Curiosity

units.content: The Traveller speedily comes to disregard the little people.
units.label: Traveller Disregards Hosts
units.state: He no longer disregards the little people but cherishes Weena's clinging fondness, watches for her, and feels returning to the White Sphinx neighbourhood almost like coming home.

units.content: The machine's dials record the date as A.D. 802,701.
units.label: Machine's Far Future Date
units.state: The dials no longer stand at 802,701; they are spinning rapidly onward into far deeper futurity.

units.content: The future world exists in a confusing condition of ruinous splendour.
units.label: Ruinous Splendour Condition
units.other_readings_json: ["The condition of ruinous splendour is now to be read as proof of perfect conquest: vast grandeur as what conquest built and ruin as what contented inactivity then allowed."]
units.reading: The condition of ruinous splendour is now to be understood as the aftermath of the civilising climax, where complete security removed need and left splendour without vigour to maintain it.

units.content: A great heap of granite bound with aluminium forms a vast derelict remnant.
units.label: Granite Aluminium Ruin
units.other_readings_json: ["Granite Aluminium Ruin is now also to be read as grandeur built by perfect conquest then left derelict after secure energy passed through art into languor."]
units.reading: Granite Aluminium Ruin is now also to be read as splendour left derelict because security removed need and vigour to maintain it.

units.content: The narrator is destined to have a strange experience at that ruin to be told later.
units.label: Promised Strange Experience

units.content: Small houses, cottages and separate households have vanished, leaving only palace-like buildings among greenery.
units.label: Vanished Small Houses

units.content: The Traveller immediately interprets the absence of private houses as communism.
units.label: Communist Diagnosis

units.content: The people of the future share the same costume, hairless visage, and girlish limb form with no visible sex differences.
units.label: Uniform Sexless Appearance

units.content: The Traveller judges the future children to be extremely precocious physically, as miniatures of their parents.
units.label: Precocious Miniature Children

units.content: Family, sex specialization, and occupational differentiation were only militant necessities of an age of force, now unnecessary under balanced, secure abundance.
units.label: Obsolete Family Necessities

units.content: The Traveller warns that this explanation was only speculation at the time and fell far short of reality.
units.label: Inadequate Early Speculation

units.content: A small cupola-covered well-like structure briefly strikes the Traveller as odd.
units.label: Well Under Cupola
units.other_readings_json: ["The cupola-covered well is an inhabited access shaft with a ladder used by the pale creatures to move between surface and below, not only a ventilation shaft.", "The cupola-covered well should now be read as one node in a unified puzzle connecting wells, ventilating towers, ghostly appearances, bronze gates and the missing machine, not only as a ventilation shaft."]
units.reading: The odd cupola-covered well-like structure is now to be understood as one instance of many bronze-rimmed ventilation shafts belonging to an extensive subterranean system, not an isolated oddity.

units.content: Left alone for the first time, the Traveller pushes to the crest with a strange sense of freedom and adventure.
units.label: Solitary Climb to Crest

units.content: On the crest sits an unrecognized yellow-metal seat with griffin-head arm-rests where the Traveller rests.
units.label: Yellow Metal Seat

units.content: Below lies the Thames valley at sunset with the river gleaming like burnished steel among palaces and greenery.
units.label: Sunset Thames Panorama
units.reading: The Thames valley sunset is now also to be read as a figure for mankind's own sunset, in addition to remaining a scenic panorama.

units.content: The whole earth has become a garden with no hedges, property marks, or agriculture.
units.label: Earth Become Garden
units.reading: Earth Become Garden is now also to be read as subjugated nature left untended after need and vigour faded.

units.content: The Traveller warns that the evening interpretation he is about to give is only a half-truth.
units.label: Partial Interpretation Warning

units.content: The Traveller perceives the future humanity he has found as declining toward its end.
units.label: Humanity Upon the Wane
units.other_readings_json: ["Humanity upon the wane should now also be understood as total erasure where all human activity and memory have been swept out of existence, leaving only frail creatures."]
units.reading: Humanity upon the wane is now to be understood as differentiation into two distinct species, not simple decline of a single humanity.

units.content: The ruddy sunset becomes a figure for mankind's own decline.
units.label: Sunset of Mankind

units.content: Strength comes from need, so perfect security rewards feebleness.
units.label: Security Rewards Feebleness

units.content: The true civilising process progressively makes life more secure until reaching a climax.
units.label: Civilising Amelioration Climax
units.reading: The civilising climax is now to be understood as passed, with balanced civilisation past its zenith and sunk into degeneration.

units.content: A future intelligent, cooperative world will deliberately reshape animal and plant life to suit human needs.
units.label: Future Subjugation of Nature
units.reading: Future Subjugation of Nature is now to be read as a mistaken cooperative ideal exposed as Aristocratic Triumph Over Fellow-Man rather than a future moral reshaping of life.

units.content: The future natural world is cleansed of pests, weeds, fungi, and disease.
units.label: Cleansed Disease-Free Nature

units.content: Future mankind lives in splendid shelter and clothing with no toil, struggle, or commerce.
units.label: Toilless Social Paradise
units.reading: Toilless Social Paradise is now also to be read as the perfect security that made strength useless and sent surplus energy through brief art into languor.

units.content: The Traveller guesses the future solved overpopulation so numbers ceased to increase.
units.label: Population Growth Halted

units.content: Human intelligence and vigour are produced by hardship and freedom rewarding the strong and capable.
units.label: Hardship Builds Intelligence

units.content: Family jealousy, maternity, and passion lose justification without danger and become uncomfortable savage discords.
units.label: Passions as Savage Survivals

units.content: The Traveller interprets frail people and vast ruins as proof of humanity's perfect conquest of nature.
units.label: Perfect Conquest of Nature
units.other_readings_json: ["Perfect Conquest of Nature is now also to be read as a daylight illusion sustained by hidden underground labour for the Capitalist-descended surface branch rather than true conquest.", "Perfect conquest should now also be read as an aristocratic domination carrying the present industrial system to its conclusion, not a moral or cooperative triumph over nature."]
units.reading: Perfect Conquest of Nature should now be read as a daylight-only illusion undermined by persisting dread beyond daylight.

units.content: Under perfect comfort and security, the restless energy that is strength for Victorians would become weakness.
units.label: Strength Becomes Weakness

units.content: After countless years without war, beasts, disease, or toil, the weak are as well equipped as the strong.
units.label: World Without Danger or Toil

units.content: Secure energy inevitably turns to art and eroticism, then to languor and decay.
units.label: Energy Decays Through Art

units.content: Pain and necessity are a grindstone that kept humans keen, and here that hateful grindstone is finally broken.
units.label: Broken Grindstone of Necessity
units.state: Pain and necessity are no longer finally broken everywhere; after thousands of years necessity has returned below.

units.content: The Traveller believes his simple explanation has mastered the whole secret of the future people.
units.label: Mastered World Problem
units.reading: The confident claim to have mastered the whole secret is now to be understood as mistaken overconfidence in an obvious sanitary interpretation that is retracted as absolutely wrong.

units.content: The Traveller theorizes that population checks succeeded too well and numbers declined, explaining the ruins.
units.label: Over-successful Population Checks

units.content: A yellow gibbous moon rises in silver light as night falls and the little people disappear.
units.label: Gibbous Moon Rising
units.reading: Gibbous Moon Rising should now be read as the nightly onset of fearful hours confirmed by dawn apparitions rather than mere picturesque nightfall.
units.state: The moon is no longer gibbous and bright; it is waning toward its last quarter with nights growing dark.

units.content: The Traveller realizes with shock that the Time Machine is gone from the lawn by the Sphinx.
units.label: Time Machine Vanished
units.state: The Time Machine is no longer missing from the lawn but is recovered waiting inside the Sphinx.

units.content: The Traveller is gripped by the physical dread of losing his own age and being left helpless.
units.label: Fear of Stranded Helplessness

units.content: In a passion of fear the Traveller runs with leaping strides down the slope toward the lawn.
units.label: Frantic Downhill Run

units.content: The Traveller confronts the empty space where the Time Machine stood and feels faint and cold.
units.label: Empty space confrontation

units.content: The moonlit sphinx appears to smile in mockery of the Traveller's dismay.
units.label: Mocking sphinx smile

units.content: The Traveller is dismayed by the sense that some unknown power intervened to make his invention vanish.
units.label: Unsuspected intervening power

units.content: The Traveller concludes the machine was not moved in time but only hidden in space.
units.label: Hidden only in space

units.content: In frenzy the Traveller beats the bushes until his knuckles are gashed and bleeding.
units.label: Bloody bush beating
units.state: The gashed bleeding knuckles are now half-healed scars examined after the story.

units.content: The great stone building's big hall is dark, silent, and deserted when the Traveller enters.
units.label: Dark deserted hall

units.content: The Traveller finds a second cushioned hall where many little people are sleeping.
units.label: Cushioned sleeping hall
units.reading: The cushioned hall of sleepers should now be understood not as casual rest but as the fear-driven nightly huddle against darkness.

units.content: The Traveller bawls for his Time Machine while seizing and shaking the little people.
units.label: Angry demand for machine

units.content: The Traveller believes fear has been forgotten in these people based on their daylight behavior.
units.label: Fear forgotten belief
units.reading: The belief that fear is forgotten should now be read as true only of daylight behaviour; dawn apparitions and lingering foreboding show dread persists beyond daylight.

units.content: Maddened by his loss, the Traveller raves to and fro screaming upon God and Fate.
units.label: Nightlong maddened raving

units.content: After utter misery the Traveller sleeps outside and wakes in full day with sparrows nearby.
units.label: Sleep to morning sparrows

units.content: The Traveller wakes in morning freshness able to face his circumstances rationally after overnight frenzy.
units.label: Morning Calm Recovery

units.content: He resolves to be calm and patient to learn the people and recover or eventually remake the machine.
units.label: Calm Patient Resolve

units.content: His attempts to question the little people fail, meeting incomprehension and mocking laughter.
units.label: Failed Questioning Attempt

units.content: He discovers a groove ripped in the turf pointing from his arrival marks toward the sphinx pedestal.
units.label: Groove Discovery Clue

units.content: The bronze sphinx pedestal is hollow with framed panels that look like doors opening from within.
units.label: Hollow Bronze Pedestal
units.reading: The hollow pedestal is also to be read as a forbidden object whose opening provokes horror and insult, in addition to being a hollow container with door-like panels.
units.state: The bronze pedestal is now slammed shut with the Traveller sealed in darkness inside.

units.content: He infers that his Time Machine is inside that pedestal, though how it got there is still unknown.
units.label: Machine Inside Pedestal

units.content: The Eloi treat the Traveller's gesture toward opening the pedestal as a gross insult and withdraw.
units.label: Eloi Horror at Request

units.content: The Traveller angrily seizes an Eloi by the robe to drag him to the sphinx but releases him on seeing horror.
units.label: Seizing Eloi Guide

units.content: The Traveller batters the bronze panels with a river pebble, flattening decoration and scattering verdigris without opening it.
units.label: Hammering Bronze Pedestal

units.content: The Traveller thinks he hears a chuckle stirring inside the pedestal but dismisses it as mistaken.
units.label: Chuckle Inside Pedestal
units.reading: The chuckle stirring inside the pedestal should now be understood as real Morlock mocking laughter, not a mistake, anticipating the mocking pursuit in the dark.

units.content: A crowd of Eloi watches the hammering from the slopes at a distance without intervening.
units.label: Furtive Eloi Onlookers

units.content: The Traveller claims he can work for years but cannot endure inactive waiting.
units.label: Occidental Restless Temperament

units.content: The Traveller tells himself that patience and leaving the sphinx alone is the only way to recover his machine.
units.label: Resolve to leave sphinx

units.content: The Traveller sees the humor in having trapped himself in the future after years of work to reach it.
units.label: Self-made hopeless trap

units.content: The little people seem to avoid the Traveller, possibly because of his hammering at the bronze gates.
units.label: Eloi avoidance after hammering

units.content: The Eloi language appears excessively simple, built almost only from concrete nouns, verbs, and two-word sentences.
units.label: Excessively simple Eloi language

units.content: Despite deciding to shelve the mystery, the Traveller feels tethered within a few miles of his arrival point.
units.label: Tethered near arrival point

units.content: The future world appears uniformly rich with splendid buildings, greenery, shining water, and distant blue hills.
units.label: Lush uniform future landscape

units.content: Deep circular wells rimmed with bronze and capped with cupolas punctuate the hillsides.
units.label: Bronze-rimmed circular wells
units.other_readings_json: ["The bronze-rimmed circular wells should now be read as nodes in the unified puzzle linking wells, towers, ghosts, bronze gates and the missing machine while remaining inhabited access shafts."]
units.reading: The Bronze-rimmed circular wells are now to be read as inhabited access shafts with ladders used by the pale branch to move between surface and below, not only as ventilation shafts.

units.content: The shafts contain no water but emit an engine-like thudding and a strong downdraft that sucks paper out of sight.
units.label: Throbbing inhaling shaft test
units.reading: The throbbing inhaling shaft test should now be read as a physical trace of deeper inhabited activity feeding the unified puzzle, not only as evidence for ventilation.

units.content: The wells linked to shimmering towers suggest an extensive system of subterranean ventilation.
units.label: Subterranean ventilation system
units.other_readings_json: ["Subterranean ventilation system is now also to be read as a rent-extraction apparatus enforcing the Haves Above Workers Below split, in addition to airways for an inhabited Underworld."]
units.reading: Subterranean ventilation system is now to be read as airways for an inhabited artificial Underworld housing the subterranean race and its labour rather than mere ventilation.

units.content: The Traveller admits his first obvious sanitary interpretation of the ventilation was absolutely wrong.
units.label: Rejected sanitary explanation

units.content: The Traveller admits he learned very little about future drains, conveyance, and similar conveniences.
units.label: Learned little of infrastructure

units.content: Details easy to invent for imaginary Utopias are inaccessible to a real traveller amid actual realities.
units.label: Imagined versus real traveller

units.content: The Traveller likens his position to a Central African trying to report London to his tribe.
units.label: African visitor in London

units.content: Despite unseen comforts, the Traveller retains only a general impression of automatic organisation.
units.label: Automatic organisation impression
units.reading: The impression of automatic organisation is now to be understood as a provisional first theory that the Traveller has abandoned as unsatisfying, not a retained conclusion.

units.content: The Traveller sees no crematoria, tombs, or cemeteries within his range of exploration.
units.label: Absence of burial signs
units.reading: Absence of burial signs should now be read as pointing to hidden disposal of the dead by the burden-carrying white creatures rather than absence of death.

units.content: The Traveller observes with growing puzzlement that there are no aged or infirm among the future people.
units.label: No aged or infirm

units.content: The Traveller's satisfaction with his theories of automatic civilisation and decadent humanity does not last.
units.label: Failed First Theories

units.content: Clothes and metalwork must be made, yet no machinery, shops, or creativity is visible and upkeep is inexplicable.
units.label: Unexplained Material Upkeep

units.content: The world of 802,701 feels like an inscription mixing plain English with utterly unknown words.
units.label: Partly Unreadable World

units.content: None of the little people makes any attempt to rescue the drowning one before their eyes.
units.label: Bystander Eloi Inaction

units.content: The Traveller wades in lower down and drags the drowning mite safe to land.
units.label: Traveller Rescues Drowner

units.content: The rescued little woman is identified as Weena, a name that seems appropriate.
units.label: Weena Named Companion

units.content: Weena greets the Traveller with delight and a large garland made for him alone.
units.label: Garland Greeting Gift

units.content: They sit together in a stone arbour exchanging smiles, flowers, and hand-kisses.
units.label: Arbour Smile Exchange

units.content: The narrator frames this meeting as the start of a queer week-long friendship that will end.
units.label: Week-Long Friendship Foretold

units.content: The Traveller insists he must master the world rather than carry on a miniature flirtation.
units.label: Exploration Over Flirtation Duty

units.content: Weena's fondness makes returning to the White Sphinx feel like coming home as he watches for her.
units.label: Coming Home Watching

units.content: Fear still exists in the future world, concentrated for Weena in darkness and black things.
units.label: Enduring Fear of Darkness
units.reading: Enduring Fear of Darkness should now also be read as well-founded dread of being seized by Morlocks in the dark, with sunlight and Eloi companionship as relief.

units.content: The little people gather into great houses after dark and sleep in droves, never alone.
units.label: Eloi Huddle After Dark

units.content: The Traveller admits he was a blockhead to miss the lesson of that fear and sleep apart.
units.label: Traveller Missed The Lesson
units.reading: Traveller Missed The Lesson now also reads as his failure to grasp that fear of darkness meant literal danger of being seized by Morlocks.

units.content: For five nights Weena overcomes her distress and sleeps with her head pillowed on the Traveller's arm.
units.label: Weena Sleeps On Arm

units.content: Waking restless from a drowning dream, the Traveller imagines a greyish animal has just rushed from the chamber.
units.label: Dawn Nightmare And Intruder
units.reading: The fancy of a greyish animal rushing from the chamber should now be understood as likely a real glimpse of the same hasty white creatures seen at dawn, not mere dream-confusion.

units.content: The Traveller observes dawn breaking in a ghastly mingling of dying moonlight and pallor.
units.label: Ghastly dawn half-light

units.content: The Traveller repeatedly sees white figures moving hastily on the hill and vanishing.
units.label: White figures on hill
units.reading: White figures on hill are now to be read as real surface forays of the light-sensitive subterranean race rather than insubstantial half-light apparitions.

units.content: A leash of the white creatures near the ruins is seen carrying some dark body.
units.label: Leash carrying dark body

units.content: In full daylight the Traveller finds no trace of them and calls them mere creatures of half-light.
units.label: Dismissal as ghosts
units.reading: Absence by day and appearance as creatures of half-light should now be understood as daytime retreat underground by a light-sensitive race, not as insubstantiality.

units.content: The Traveller warns that these figures are soon to take deadlier possession of his mind.
units.label: Foreboding deadlier possession

units.content: The sun in this future age is very much hotter than in the Traveller's own time.
units.label: Hotter Sun Fact
units.state: The sun is now even larger and duller with snow beginning, far beyond merely being hotter.

units.content: Planets falling back into the sun could make it blaze with renewed energy.
units.label: Planets Falling Into Sun

units.content: On a hot fourth morning the Traveller seeks shelter in a colossal ruin near his sleeping place.
units.label: Shelter In Ruined Gallery

units.content: Luminous eyes watch the Traveller out of the darkness inside the gallery.
units.label: Eyes Watching In Dark

units.content: A queer little ape-like figure runs across the sunlit space and hides in shadow after being touched.
units.label: Ape Figure Flees Light

units.content: The creature is pale with large eyes and flaxen hair on its head and back.
units.label: Pale Nocturnal Creature

units.content: The Traveller follows the fleeing thing into a second heap of ruins.
units.label: Pursuit Into Ruins

units.content: By match light the Traveller sees the small white creature retreating down the shaft.
units.label: Well Shaft Sighting
units.reading: The well shaft sighting should now be read as the unassimilable Lemur encounter that breaks the balanced-organization scheme and supplies the unified clue, as well as proof of habitation.

units.content: The Traveller perceives the clambering creature as like a human spider.
units.label: Human Spider Image

units.content: Metal foot and hand rests form a kind of ladder down the shaft.
units.label: Shaft Ladder Rests

units.content: Humanity has differentiated from one species into two distinct animals.
units.label: Humanity Split Species

units.content: The Traveller begins to suspect his underground ventilation idea conceals a deeper true meaning.
units.label: Ventilation true import doubt
units.other_readings_json: ["Ventilation shafts are now also to be read as instruments of economic coercion where underground dwellers pay rent for air or face starvation and suffocation."]
units.reading: Ventilation shafts are now to be understood as airways for an inhabited artificial Underworld that houses the subterranean race and its work, resolving the earlier suspicion of a hidden import.

units.content: The Traveller cannot fit the Lemur into his scheme of a perfectly balanced organization.
units.label: Lemur balance scheme puzzle

units.content: The Traveller resolves he must descend the well yet is absolutely afraid to go.
units.label: Resolve versus fear
units.state: The deadlock of must descend yet afraid to go is over; he has committed to and begun the descent into the well.
