units.content: The beautiful upperworld people appear distressed to find the Traveller peering down the well.
units.label: Overworlders distressed at well

units.content: The Traveller now has a clue linking the wells, ventilating towers, ghosts, bronze gates, and Time Machine.
units.label: Emerging unified explanation clue

units.content: The second species of Man is plainly subterranean.
units.label: Subterranean Second Species

units.content: Bleached skin, reflective large eyes, and confused flight from sunshine together prove extreme retinal sensitivity from long underground habit.
units.label: Extreme Retinal Sensitivity

units.content: The earth beneath his feet is enormously tunnelled as the habitat of the New Race.
units.label: Tunnelled Underground Habitat
units.reading: Tunnelled Underground Habitat is now also to be read as rented caverns for which the Workers pay ventilation rent, in addition to habitat of the New Race.

units.content: Work necessary to the comfort of the daylight race is done in the artificial Underworld.
units.label: Underworld Labour Service

units.content: The gradual widening of the temporary social difference between Capitalist and Labourer is the key to the splitting of humanity.
units.label: Capitalist-Labourer Split Key

units.content: Industry sank into ever-larger underground factories until it lost its birthright in the sky.
units.label: Industry Loses Sky Birthright

units.content: Richer people are already closing considerable portions of the surface land against intrusion.
units.label: Rich Enclose Countryside

units.content: The end split leaves pleasure-seeking Haves above ground and labour-adapted Workers below ground.
units.label: Haves Above Workers Below

units.content: Once underground, the Workers must pay heavy rent for ventilation or starve or suffocate for arrears.
units.label: Rent For Underground Air

units.content: Humanity's triumph was not moral cooperation but an aristocracy carrying the present industrial system to its logical conclusion.
units.label: Aristocratic Triumph Over Fellow-Man

units.content: The balanced civilisation has passed its zenith and the secure Overworlders have dwindled in size, strength, and intelligence.
units.label: Overworlder Degeneration In Decay

units.content: The Traveller becomes convinced the Morlocks took his Time Machine while doubting why the supposedly master Eloi cannot restore it.
units.label: Morlocks Stole Time Machine

units.content: When pressed about the Underworld, Weena refuses to answer and bursts into tears.
units.label: Weena Weeps About Underworld

units.content: The Morlocks inspire shrinking disgust as half-bleached, cold, worm-like pallid bodies.
units.label: Pallid Worm-like Morlocks

units.content: The waning moon will soon leave dark nights when the underground creatures can appear more abundantly.
units.label: Coming Dark Moonless Nights

units.content: Convinced he must boldly penetrate underground to recover the machine, the Traveller is appalled and paralyzed by horrid aloneness.
units.label: Traveller's Lonely Paralysis
units.state: Traveller's Lonely Paralysis is ended when Resolve for Immediate Descent overcomes horror to produce Entry Into Well Throat.

units.content: A vast, Oriental-looking pale-green building stands apart from all other palaces or ruins seen.
units.label: Palace of Green Porcelain

units.content: The Traveller admits his curiosity about the palace was self-deception to shirk the dreaded descent.
units.label: Curiosity as Self-Deception

units.content: The Traveller resolves to make the descent without further waste of time.
units.label: Resolve for Immediate Descent
units.state: The resolve for immediate descent no longer holds; his present resolve is to make arms and secure a sleeping fastness first.

units.content: Weena cries piteously and pulls at the Traveller to stop him entering the well.
units.label: Weena's Piteous Opposition

units.content: The Traveller enters the throat of the well while seeing Weena's agonised face above.
units.label: Entry Into Well Throat

units.content: A bar bends under his weight and nearly swings him off into the blackness beneath.
units.label: Bending Bar Peril

units.content: The well mouth above looks like a small blue disc containing a visible star.
units.label: Blue Disc Aperture

units.content: When he looks up again Weena is gone from the opening.
units.label: Weena Disappears Above

units.content: He considers climbing back up to leave the Underworld alone but keeps descending.
units.label: Retreat Impulse Resisted
units.state: He has now acted on the resisted impulse and climbed rapidly up the shaft to escape the Morlocks, leaving the Underworld.

units.content: He swings into a narrow horizontal tunnel opening where he can lie down and rest.
units.label: Side Tunnel Refuge

units.content: The shaft air is full of throbbing, humming machinery pumping air down.
units.label: Machinery Throb Hum

units.content: The Traveller is awakened in darkness by a soft hand touching his face.
units.label: Roused by touching hand

units.content: Underground Morlocks are white stooping creatures that see in darkness and flee from match light.
units.label: Light-fleeing underground Morlocks

units.content: The Traveller cannot speak with the Morlocks because their language differs from that of the Overworld people.
units.label: Language barrier with Morlocks

units.content: The tunnel opens into a vast dark arched cavern filled with large machine-like shapes and lurking Morlocks.
units.label: Vast machine-filled cavern

units.content: The cavern air is stuffy and carries the smell of freshly shed blood.
units.label: Blood-scented oppressive air

units.content: The Traveller asserts that the Morlocks are carnivorous.
units.label: Morlocks are meat-eaters
units.reading: The Morlocks' carnivorousness is now to be understood as feeding upon the frail surface people.

units.content: The Traveller admits he started assuming future men would certainly be infinitely ahead in appliances.
units.label: Absurd future progress assumption

units.content: He stands in the Underworld with only Nature-given weapons and powers.
units.label: Natural weapons only

units.content: In the dark a hand touches his hand and lank fingers feel over his face.
units.label: Unseen groping examination

units.content: He realizes vividly in the darkness his ignorance of their ways of thinking and doing.
units.label: Vivid realized ignorance

units.content: He makes good his retreat to the narrow tunnel under flickering matchlight.
units.label: Match-lit tunnel retreat

units.content: In blackness he hears the pursuing Morlocks rustling like wind.
units.label: Rustling dark pursuit

units.content: Several Morlocks clutch the Traveller and try to haul him back into the darkness.
units.label: Morlocks Haul Traveller Back

units.content: The Morlocks stare blindly with pale chinless faces and great lidless pinkish-grey eyes.
units.label: Nauseating Inhuman Morlocks

units.content: After being seized, the Traveller kicks free of the Morlocks and climbs rapidly up the shaft.
units.label: Violent Shaft Escape

units.content: The last part of the climb becomes agonizing as deadly nausea and faintness nearly make him fall.
units.label: Sickening Interminable Climb

units.content: The Traveller escapes into sunlight, collapses, is tended by Weena and the Eloi, then becomes insensible.
units.label: Collapse Into Sunlight

units.content: The Traveller feels his sustaining hope of escape is shattered by new discoveries.
units.label: Traveller's Shattered Hope
units.state: His sustaining hope is renewed in conditional form: he now believes forcing the bronze doors with light may recover the Time Machine and allow escape.

units.content: The Morlocks possess something inhuman and malign that makes the Traveller loathe them.
units.label: Morlocks' Malign Inhumanity

units.content: The Traveller dreads the lengthening darkness as the moon wanes toward the Dark Nights.
units.label: Dreaded Dark Nights

units.content: The old class order has reversed, with the delicate Eloi decaying while their former servants rise as their nemesis.
units.label: Reversed Class Evolution

units.content: A strange, unplaced memory of meat seen in the Underworld intrudes on the Traveller like an outside question.
units.label: Underworld Meat Memory
units.reading: The unplaced memory of meat seen in the Underworld should now be understood as a shivering realization that the meat was likely the flesh of the frail prey species.

units.content: The Traveller presents his own age as a ripe prime when fear does not paralyse and mystery has lost its terrors.
units.label: Fearless modern self

units.content: The Traveller determines without delay to make weapons and a secure sleeping fastness.
units.label: Resolve for arms

units.content: The Traveller carries Weena like a child and heads up the hills toward the south-west palace.
units.label: Long trek with Weena
units.state: The Long trek with Weena paused by Open Hill Overnight Decision has resumed as Armed flight into darkness carrying Weena into the wood and is now halted by Morlocks seize Traveller.

units.content: The palace appears after sunset as a black silhouette against a pale yellow sky.
units.label: Palace black silhouette

units.content: Weena concludes the Traveller's pockets are an eccentric kind of vases for floral decoration.
units.label: Weena flower pockets

units.content: The narrator interrupts his account to note something he found when changing his jacket.
units.label: Interrupted jacket discovery

units.content: The Traveller silently places two withered white flowers on the table before resuming his story.
units.label: Withered White Flowers
units.other_readings_json: ["The Withered White Flowers are also to be read as enduring witness that gratitude and tenderness survived in man, in addition to being silent tokens and contested proof."]
units.reading: The Withered White Flowers are now not only silent tokens but contested proof the Traveller appeals to in mute inquiry and refuses to surrender amid the Restless sceptical audience and Editor dismisses tale.

units.content: The Traveller and Weena proceed over the hill toward Wimbledon as evening hush falls.
units.label: Evening Trek Toward Wimbledon

units.content: The Palace of Green Porcelain is framed as a sought refuge from Weena's Fear.
units.label: Refuge From Her Fear

units.content: The evening stillness is felt as an expectation colored by fear of the Morlocks.
units.label: Darkling Expectant Stillness

units.content: The Traveller carries the frightened, fatigued Weena down into a valley and wades a river.
units.label: Carrying Weena Through Valley

units.content: A wide, black, endless-seeming wood blocks the Traveller's path from the brow of the next hill.
units.label: Thick Wood Barrier
units.state: The Thick Wood Barrier is again a black night wood that Armed flight into darkness enters and where Morlocks seize Traveller closes in.

units.content: Too tired to face roots, tree-boles, and hidden danger in the dark wood, he decides to spend the night on the open hill.
units.label: Open Hill Overnight Decision

units.content: Weena sleeps fast while the Traveller wraps her in his jacket and sits beside her to wait for moonrise.
units.label: Sleeping Weena Guarded

units.content: All the old constellations are gone from the sky, rearranged by vast time into unfamiliar groupings.
units.label: Unfamiliar Rearranged Stars

units.content: A very bright new red star, more splendid than Sirius, shines to the south.
units.label: New Bright Red Star

units.content: One bright planet shines kindly and steadily amid the scintillating points of light.
units.label: Kindly Steady Planet

units.content: Seeing the stars suddenly makes the Traveller feel his own troubles and earthly gravities as small.
units.label: Stars Dwarf Earthly Troubles

units.content: In only a few revolutions, all human activity and memory have been swept out of existence and replaced by frail creatures.
units.label: Civilization Swept Into Oblivion

units.content: Thinking of the fear between the two species gives the Traveller a shivering insight into what the meat he saw might be.
units.label: Horrible Realization About Meat

units.content: Little Weena sleeps beside the Traveller with her face white.
units.label: Weena White Sleeping Beside

units.content: No Morlocks approach or appear on the hill during the Traveller's night vigil.
units.label: Night Without Morlock Attack
units.reading: The night with no Morlocks on the hill should now also be understood as deliberate holding back as part of a baiting trap, not mere absence.
units.state: The Night Without Morlock Attack immunity has ended into active assault as Armed flight into darkness abandons the hill and Morlocks seize Traveller grabs coat and arm.

units.content: The Traveller sits down again, takes off his shoes, and flings them away.
units.label: Traveller Discards Painful Shoes

units.content: The Traveller and Weena go down into the wood, now green and pleasant, to find fruit and meet the laughing Eloi.
units.label: Morning Fruit Foray

units.content: The Traveller feels certain what the Morlocks' meat was and pities humanity's last feeble remnant from his heart.
units.label: Meat Horror Confirmed

units.content: The Traveller attempts scientific detachment by viewing the Eloi as mere fatted cattle preserved and preyed upon by ant-like Morlocks.
units.label: Eloi As Cattle

units.content: The Traveller tries to ward off horror by reading Morlock predation as rigorous punishment for man's selfish life on others' labour.
units.label: Selfishness Punishment Theory

units.content: The Traveller admits detachment is impossible because the Eloi's human form claims his sympathy and makes him share their degradation and Fear.
units.label: Inescapable Human Sympathy

units.content: The Traveller believes entering the bronze doors with a blaze of light will let him discover the Time Machine and escape.
units.label: Light Entry Escape Belief

units.content: The Traveller resolves to bring Weena with him back to his own time.
units.label: Resolve to Bring Weena

units.content: The Palace of Green Porcelain stands deserted and ruinous when approached about noon.
units.label: Palace of Green Porcelain

units.content: A large estuary or creek now lies where Wandsworth and Battersea must once have been.
units.label: Future Thames Estuary

units.content: Weena has no idea of writing yet seems more human than she is because her affection is so human.
units.label: Weena Without Writing

units.content: The Traveller and Weena enter a dust-covered, side-lit long gallery resembling a museum.
units.label: Dusty Museum Gallery

units.content: The hall contains huge extinct-animal skeletons including Megatherium-like and Brontosaurus remains.
units.label: Giant Fossil Skeletons

units.content: The Traveller concludes the ruins are a latter-day South Kensington palaeontological collection.
units.label: Future South Kensington

units.content: Decay continues extremely slowly after the extinction of bacteria and fungi removed most of its force.
units.label: Slowed Universal Decay

units.content: Weena quietly takes the Traveller's hand and stands beside him.
units.label: Weena Takes Hand
units.state: Weena is no longer beside the Traveller holding his hand; she has vanished amid the fire.

units.content: The Traveller hopes the palace contains historical galleries or even a library.
units.label: Hoped-for Library Galleries

units.content: Seeing sulphur makes the Traveller think of making gunpowder.
units.label: Sulphur Suggests Gunpowder

units.content: The natural history section has decayed to shrivelled stuffed animals, mummies, and dust.
units.label: Ruined Natural History

units.content: A vast dim gallery holds huge, mostly corroded and broken machines on both sides.
units.label: Corroded Machine Hall

units.content: The Traveller hopes understanding the machines will give him powers useful against the Morlocks.
units.label: Machines Against Morlocks

units.content: The gallery slopes downward until daylight narrows and ends in thick darkness.
units.label: Darkening Sloped Gallery

units.content: Weena suddenly presses close to the Traveller, her growing apprehension alerting him to the fading light.
units.label: Weena's Fearful Clinging

units.content: The Traveller spots small narrow footprints breaking the dust toward the dim end of the gallery.
units.label: Morlock Footprints In Dust

units.content: The Traveller hears peculiar pattering and well-like noises coming from the remote blackness.
units.label: Pattering From Dark Depths

units.content: The Traveller snaps a lever from a machine to make a mace sufficient for a Morlock skull.
units.label: Lever Snapped Into Mace

units.content: The Traveller confesses he longed to kill Morlocks despite their being his own descendants.
units.label: Urge To Kill Morlocks

units.content: The Traveller leaves the gallery holding his mace in one hand and Weena in the other.
units.label: Armed exit with Weena
units.state: The Traveller is no longer holding Weena after the Armed exit with Weena, because she has vanished amid the fire.

units.content: The larger gallery resembles a military chapel hung with tattered flags that are actually decayed books.
units.label: Decayed library gallery

units.content: The rotting paper strikes the Traveller as enormous wasted labour, recalling his own scientific papers.
units.label: Waste of labour

units.content: In the chemistry gallery the Traveller finds a box of perfectly dry matches in an air-tight case.
units.label: Dry matches discovery
units.state: The box of dry matches found in the chemistry gallery is now gone, lost while Morlocks cling to him.

units.content: Possessing a weapon against the feared creatures, the Traveller performs an inventive whistling dance for Weena's delight.
units.label: Triumphant composite dance

units.content: The matches' preservation was fortunate, yet camphor's survival was even unlikelier.
units.label: Fortunate yet stranger survival

units.content: The camphor survived inside a sealed jar presumed hermetically closed.
units.label: Sealed camphor jar

units.content: He pockets the camphor because it burns brightly like an excellent candle.
units.label: Camphor kept for flame

units.content: Many guns survive fairly sound but lack usable powder, leaving the iron crowbar best against the bronze gates.
units.label: Sound guns without powder

units.content: Yielding to impulse, he writes his name on the nose of a South American steatite monster idol.
units.label: Signing steatite monster nose

units.content: He discovers what he takes to be two dynamite cartridges in an air-tight case.
units.label: False Dynamite Discovery

units.content: His test wait produces no explosion, revealing the cartridges as dummies.
units.label: Failed Explosion Wait

units.content: He believes live explosives would have led him to destroy the Sphinx, doors, and his own chance at the Time Machine.
units.label: Averted Self Sabotage

units.content: He and his companion rest in a turfed palace court with three fruit-trees.
units.label: Palace Court Rest

units.content: He counts his matches and pocketed camphor as means to make a protective blaze against the Morlocks.
units.label: Fire Against Morlocks
units.state: Fire Against Morlocks protection is now unavailable because Useless Matches Crisis leaves Loose Matches Discovery unlightable without the box.

units.content: He now hopes his iron bar will suffice to force the not-very-strong bronze doors.
units.label: Plan To Force Doors
units.reading: The iron bar hoped to force the bronze doors is also to be read as an effective melee weapon that can beat Morlocks back and fight free.

units.content: The Traveller leads Weena out of the Palace intending to push through the woods toward the White Sphinx by morning.
units.label: Evening march toward Sphinx

units.content: Burdened with gathered sticks and overcome by tiredness, the pair are delayed until full night before reaching the wood.
units.label: Tired firewood-laden progress

units.content: Sleepless for a night and two days, the Traveller feels feverish, irritable, and haunted by impending calamity.
units.label: Feverish sleepless dread

units.content: Three crouching figures lurk dimly in the black bushes behind the hesitating pair.
units.label: Three crouching figures

units.content: Forced to drop his firewood to free his hands, the Traveller decides to light it to startle pursuers and cover retreat.
units.label: Plan to burn firewood

units.content: Flame is vanishingly rare without humans in a temperate climate.
units.label: Rarity of natural flame

units.content: In this future decadence humanity has forgotten the art of making fire.
units.label: Fire-making forgotten art

units.content: Weena finds the flames wholly new and wants to run to and play with them.
units.label: Weena drawn to flame

units.content: The Traveller's heap ignites adjacent bushes into a line of fire creeping uphill.
units.label: Set fire spreading uphill

units.content: The Traveller plunges into the black wood carrying Weena on one arm and his iron bar in the other.
units.label: Armed flight into darkness

units.content: Pursuing Morlocks close in and seize at the Traveller's coat and arm while Weena freezes.
units.label: Morlocks seize Traveller

units.content: Morlocks silently struggle around his knees and creep over his coat and neck while he fumbles for a match.
units.label: Morlocks Grapple in Dark

units.content: Lighting a match reveals the white backs of Morlocks fleeing among the trees.
units.label: Match Drives Morlocks Off

units.content: Weena lies face-down clutching his feet, motionless and scarcely breathing as if fainted.
units.label: Weena Lies Motionless
units.state: Weena now lies beside the iron mace like one dead and cannot be revived.

units.content: Turning about during the struggle leaves the Traveller with no idea which way his path lies.
units.label: Traveller Lost Direction

units.content: He decides to build a fire and encamp where they are.
units.label: Decision to Encamp
units.state: The encampment fire is no longer a controlled campfire but a raging forest fire advancing through the trees.

units.content: Morlock eyes shine like carbuncles out of the surrounding darkness.
units.label: Carbuncle Morlock Eyes

units.content: The Traveller drags down branches to make a choking smoky fire that lets him save camphor.
units.label: Building smoky bonfire
units.state: The fire made in Building smoky bonfire is no longer a controlled choking campfire but part of the raging forest fire advancing through the trees.

units.content: Weena lies beside the iron mace like one dead and cannot be revived.
units.label: Weena lying lifeless

units.content: The Traveller nods off and wakes in darkness to find the Morlocks already holding him.
units.label: Waking to Morlock seizure

units.content: The Traveller discovers his match-box is gone while Morlocks cling to him.
units.label: Losing the match-box
units.reading: Losing the match-box is now a total loss of fire-making power because Useless Matches Crisis makes Loose Matches Discovery unusable without the box.

units.content: Being heaped upon in darkness feels like being caught in a monstrous spider's web.
units.label: Monstrous spider web horror

units.content: The Traveller finds his iron lever while down and uses it to fight free.
units.label: Counterattack with iron lever

units.content: The Traveller braces with his back to a tree, resolved to make the Morlocks pay despite believing he and Weena are lost.
units.label: Doomed Last Stand

units.content: The Morlocks stop attacking and stream past the Traveller away through the wood.
units.label: Morlocks Fleeing Past

units.content: The Traveller sees his earlier fire has become a burning forest advancing behind him.
units.label: Forest Fire Realization

units.content: When the Traveller looks for Weena amid the fire, she is gone.
units.label: Weena Disappears

units.content: A fleeing Morlock blunders past the Traveller and runs straight into the fire.
units.label: Morlock Runs Into Fire

units.content: The whole space is as bright as day with the reflection of the fire.
units.label: Fire-Ringed Bright Clearing

units.content: Some thirty or forty Morlocks are dazzled by the light and heat.
units.label: Dazzled Morlock Crowd

units.content: He strikes furiously at the approaching Morlocks with his bar in a frenzy of fear.
units.label: Frenzied Bar Attack

units.content: The Morlocks are absolutely helpless and miserable in the glare, so he strikes no more of them.
units.label: Morlocks Helpless in Glare

units.content: He spends most of the night convinced it is a nightmare, hurting himself and praying to awake.
units.label: Nightmare Denial Night

units.content: Three suffering Morlocks put their heads down and rush into the flames as daylight approaches.
units.label: Morlocks Rush Into Flames

units.content: He finds no trace of Weena and takes relief in believing her body escaped a worse fate in the forest.
units.label: Weena Lost But Spared

units.content: He orients by the Palace toward the White Sphinx and limps across smoking ashes to the Time Machine.
units.label: Limp Toward Time Machine

units.content: Grieving Weena and exhausted, he feels terribly alone and aches painfully for home and his listeners.
units.label: Lonely Homesick Longing

units.content: The Traveller discovers loose matches still in his trouser pocket after the box was lost.
units.label: Loose Matches Discovery
units.reading: The loose matches in the trouser pocket should now also be understood as strike-on-box kind effectively useless without the box.

units.content: The Traveller returns in the morning to the yellow metal seat where he first viewed the future world.
units.label: Return to Overlook Seat

units.content: Seeing Eloi bathing where he saved Weena gives the Traveller a sharp stab of pain.
units.label: Stab of Weena Memory

units.content: The cupolas leading to the Underworld appear as blots spoiling the beautiful Overworld landscape.
units.label: Cupolas as Landscape Blots

units.content: The Overworld people live as pleasantly and heedlessly as cattle, sharing cattle's same end as prey.
units.label: Eloi as Unwary Cattle

units.content: Human intellect destroyed itself by pursuing comfort, ease, and a balanced society secured by permanency.
units.label: Comfort-Seeking Intellectual Suicide

units.content: Intellectual versatility exists only as compensation for change, danger, and trouble.
units.label: Intelligence Requires Change

units.content: The Upperworld drifted toward feeble prettiness while the Underworld drifted toward mere mechanical industry.
units.label: Divided Human Degeneration

units.content: After being staved off for thousands of years, necessity returned below when Underworld feeding became disjointed.
units.label: Necessity Returns Below

units.content: When other meat failed, the Underworld turned to food that old habit had hitherto forbidden.
units.label: Turn To Forbidden Meat

units.content: Exhausted by fatigue and terror, the Traveller spreads himself on the turf for a long refreshing sleep.
units.label: Traveller Falls Asleep

units.content: The Traveller walks down to the White Sphinx carrying a crowbar and matches.
units.label: Armed Approach to Sphinx

units.content: The Traveller finds the Sphinx's bronze valves already open.
units.label: Open Bronze Valves

units.content: The Time Machine is waiting inside the Sphinx's small apartment.
units.label: Recovered Time Machine Inside

units.content: The Traveller believes he finally understands the Morlocks are baiting him into a trap.
units.label: Recognized Morlock Trap

units.content: The bronze panels slam shut and leave the Traveller trapped in darkness.
units.label: Panels Slam Shut

units.content: The Traveller's matches are of a kind that lights only on the box.
units.label: Useless Matches Crisis

units.content: A Morlock touches the Traveller and he swings at them in the dark with the levers.
units.label: Morlock Touch and Counterblow

units.content: After a desperate scramble, the Traveller finally fixes and pulls the lever to escape.
units.label: Lever Fixed and Pulled

units.content: Instead of going back, the Traveller has mistakenly set the machine to travel forward.
units.label: Accidental Forward Time Travel

units.content: The thousands-day dial spins as fast as a seconds hand, showing a rush into the far future.
units.label: Rush Into Deep Futurity

units.content: The far-future sun hangs huge, red, and motionless on the horizon.
units.label: Motionless Red Sun
units.state: The Motionless Red Sun is no longer fully obscured by eclipse darkness; its edge has reappeared as a red-hot bow.

units.content: Tidal friction has finished its work and locked Earth with one face to the sun.
units.label: Tidal Drag Completed

units.content: The sky is split between black starry darkness and red glow where a huge motionless red sun sits on the horizon.
units.label: Motionless Red Sun Sky
units.state: The sky is no longer split between black starry darkness and red glow with motionless sun; during backward travel the blinking succession of days and nights has resumed with golden sun and blue sky.

units.content: The Time Machine rests on a sloping beach beside a windless sea.
units.label: Sloping Salt-Edged Beach

units.content: The Traveller feels head oppression and rapid breathing from rarefied air.
units.label: Rarefied Oppressive Air

units.content: A huge white butterfly-like thing screams harshly and flutters away over distant hillocks.
units.label: Screaming Butterfly Flight

units.content: The reddish mass near the Traveller is really a monstrous crab-like creature.
units.label: Monstrous Crab Creature
units.state: By more than thirty million years on the monstrous crabs are gone and the red beach is lifeless and flecked with white.

units.content: Another monster crab stands just behind the Traveller and reaches for him with eyestalks, hungry mouth, and slime-smeared claws.
units.label: Crab Ambush From Behind

units.content: The Traveller puts his hand on the lever and places a month between himself and the monsters.
units.label: Escape By Time Lever

units.content: The far-future world hangs in abominable desolation of red sky, black north, dead salt sea, crab-covered beach, and poisonous green plants.
units.label: Abominable Desolate World
units.state: The far-future shore is now motionless without crabs or other animal movement; only green slime shows life persists.

units.content: A curved pale line like a vast new moon appears in the westward sky.
units.label: Vast New Moon Line
units.state: The Vast New Moon Line is no longer visible now that the Eclipse over sun has deepened into absolute darkness where Pale stars alone remain.

units.content: Drawn by the earth's fate, the Traveller journeys in thousand-year strides while watching the sun grow larger and duller.
units.label: Millennia-Long Sun Watching

units.content: More than thirty million years on the crabs have disappeared, the red beach seems lifeless, and it is flecked with white.
units.label: Crabs Gone Lifeless Snow

units.content: No animal movement remains in earth, sky, or sea.
units.label: Motionless lifeless world

units.content: Green slime on the rocks alone shows that life is not yet extinct.
units.label: Last green slime life

units.content: A bay-like black concavity grows on the sun as an eclipse begins.
units.label: Eclipse over sun

units.content: The Traveller suspects the eclipse is a nearby inner planet transiting, not the moon.
units.label: Inner planet transit theory

units.content: All familiar sounds of humans and animals are over in universal silence.
units.label: End of living sounds

units.content: Darkness becomes absolute until only pale stars remain visible.
units.label: Pale stars alone
units.state: Darkness is no longer absolute with only pale stars because the sun's edge has reappeared.

units.content: The Traveller is overcome by horror, marrow-piercing cold, painful breathing, shivering and nausea.
units.label: Overcome by cold horror

units.content: The edge of the sun reappears in the sky like a red-hot bow.
units.label: Red-hot solar edge

units.content: A black round football-sized thing with trailing tentacles hops fitfully against the blood-red water.
units.label: Hopping tentacled round thing

units.content: He travels backward as the blinking succession of days and nights resumes with golden sun and blue sky.
units.label: Backward flight through time

units.content: On repassing the departure minute Mrs. Watchett glides backward up the laboratory with every motion exactly inverted.
units.label: Reversed Mrs Watchett walk

units.content: The Traveller stops the machine to find his familiar laboratory exactly as he left it.
units.label: Familiar Laboratory Return

units.content: The machine's shift from southeast to northwest measures the distance to the White Sphinx pedestal.
units.label: Displaced Machine Evidence

units.content: Injured and begrimed, the Traveller hears his friends dining and re-enters through the door.
units.label: Dinner Guests Rejoined

units.content: The Traveller says his own safe return to familiar company feels more incredible than his adventures.
units.label: Return Feels Incredible

units.content: The Traveller offers his account to be taken as a lie, dream, or prophecy rather than believed truth.
units.label: Lie Or Prophecy Framing

units.content: The Traveller asks his audience to judge his narrative simply as a story.
units.label: Asking for Story Verdict

units.content: The audience grows restless and silent after the story ends.
units.label: Restless sceptical audience
units.state: The Restless sceptical audience has now broken up and departed with laughter in the Laughing midnight farewell.

units.content: The Editor treats the account as fiction fit for a story-writer.
units.label: Editor dismisses tale

units.content: The Time Traveller admits he hardly believes his own experience himself.
units.label: Traveller doubts himself

units.content: The Traveller gazes in mute inquiry at the withered white flowers on the table.
units.label: Withered white flowers

units.content: The Traveller looks at half-healed scars on his own knuckles.
units.label: Scarred knuckles evidence

units.content: When the Medical Man asks to have the unidentified flowers, the Traveller abruptly refuses.
units.label: Refusal to give flowers

units.content: The Traveller feels ordinary reality overwhelming his memory and fears his journey was only a dream.
units.label: Traveller doubting his memory

units.content: The Traveller seizes the lamp and leads his followers into the corridor to check the machine.
units.label: Lamp-lit dash to corridor

units.content: The machine is physically present, solid and touchable, marked by stains, grass, moss, and a bent rail.
units.label: Solid travel-stained machine

units.content: After touching the damaged rail the Traveller declares that the story he told was true.
units.label: Story affirmed as true

units.content: The party breaks up with an overwork diagnosis, laughter, and the Traveller shouting good-night from the doorway.
units.label: Laughing midnight farewell

units.content: The Editor dismisses the tale as a gaudy lie while the narrator remains unable to conclude after a sleepless night.
units.label: Divided Aftermath of Tale

units.content: Alone in the empty laboratory, the narrator stares at the Time Machine and touches its lever.
units.label: Touching the Lever

units.content: The squat substantial-looking mass sways unsteadily like a wind-shaken bough.
units.label: Swaying Machine Vision

units.content: The Time Traveller appears from the house carrying a small camera and a knapsack.
units.label: Equipped Departing Traveller

units.content: The Traveller promises to prove time travelling completely with specimens if the narrator stays to lunch.
units.label: Promise of Proof

units.content: Remembering a two o’clock engagement, the narrator gets up to tell the Time Traveller he must go.
units.label: Leaving to Warn Traveller

units.content: The narrator enters amid noise and gust to find the Time Traveller gone from the laboratory.
units.label: Traveller's Abrupt Vanishing

units.content: The narrator waits on for the Traveller, but he has now been absent for three years.
units.label: Three-Year Vain Waiting

units.content: The narrator imagines the Traveller may be lost wandering among remote prehistoric ages.
units.label: Speculated Prehistoric Wanderings

units.content: To the narrator the future remains a black and blank vast ignorance.
units.label: Future as Black Blank

units.content: Two shrivelled white flowers remain as witness that gratitude and tenderness survived in man.
units.label: Withered White Flowers Witness
